description.part1: In my personal project, The Shopping Hub, I developed a full-stack e-commerce website using React.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB. The application includes user authentication, product search, shopping cart, order management, order history, and profile management. It also features a role-based admin panel for managing products, users, and orders, along with a dashboard that provides an overview of store activity. RESTful APIs handle communication between the frontend and backend, while MongoDB is used for data management.

In my graduation project, I designed and developed the admin panel of a Smart Home System web application. The panel enables administrators to monitor device statuses and manage smart home devices through a centralized interface. I built the interface using React.js and integrated RESTful APIs for data communication and management. I focused on reusable components, state management, and creating a modular and maintainable application structure.

I developed an employee tracking system using ASP.NET Core MVC, SQL Server, and Entity Framework. The application allows administrators to manage employee information, including personal details, department, salary, and email, through a centralized interface. It includes features for adding, viewing, updating, and deleting employee records, along with dedicated detail pages for each employee, with a focus on CRUD operations, database integration, and a clear and maintainable MVC application structure.

During my internship, I developed a customer billing system using C#, Windows Forms, ADO.NET, and SQL Server. The application allows users to manage customer, product, and invoice data, define product categories and promotions, and automatically generate invoices based on customer information and purchased products. It also supports exporting customer and product data to Excel for further analysis.

During my internship, I developed a customer invoicing application using C#, Windows Forms, ADO.NET, and SQL Server. The application allows administrators to retrieve customer information using a customer code, manage invoice items, and calculate both foreign and local currency amounts. It also supports exporting invoice data to Excel, with a focus on database operations, invoice management, and accurate data processing.
